decisions.decision: One Prompt class: core Prompt extends Task; the old ext/Refine Prompt is renamed PromptRun (it keeps scoring/view, borrows KINDS/OUTCOMES/SETTLED).
options: make the Refine class extend Task (drags a demo view and scorer into core)

decisions.decision: Dual-write: prompts.jsonl stays (Coverage, Dictate, Echo read it) and PromptRecords also mirrors each Prompt into session.jsonl.
options: write only session.jsonl (breaks the Coverage card and Dictate)

decisions.decision: Questions nest under the Prompt's tasks and also carry from; root Questions with a matching from are found too.
Sentence ids are computed from paragraphs; migrated paragraphs carry explicit sentences so old cites keep meaning.
Already-filed asks stay at the session root, linked by source.prompt / from. Old folders with no session.jsonl are skipped by the migration.
